title: 164. First Missing Positive

examples.explanation: The numbers in the range [1,2] are all in the array.
1 is in the array but 2 is missing.
The smallest positive integer 1 is missing.

hints: Place each value v with 1 <= v <= n at index v-1 by swapping (cyclic sort), ignoring others.
Then the first index i with nums[i] != i+1 gives answer i+1; otherwise n+1.
